security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost;

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first obligation and evidence governance workspace.
bundle.longDescription: NEXUS is a local-first desktop workspace for organizational obligation, evidence and approval governance. It stores all business data in a local SQLite database on the user's device; readiness indicators are local operational estimates and are not a legal compliance assertion. NOTE: publisher and copyright metadata are intentionally unset until the owner approves the legal identity (see docs/legal/LEGAL_OWNER_GATE_AR.md).
